meaning: I don't understand a thing; it's all Greek to me
example: Kannst du das noch mal erklären? [Ich verstehe nur Bahnhof].
example_en: Can you explain that again? It's all Greek to me.

meaning: to miss something obvious
literal: to have tomatoes on your eyes
example: Du [hast] wohl [Tomaten auf den Augen]! Der Schlüssel liegt direkt vor dir.
example_en: Are you blind? The key is right in front of you.

meaning: I don't care; it's all the same to me
example: Pizza oder Pasta? [Das ist mir Wurst].
example_en: Pizza or pasta? I don't mind either way.

meaning: to pull someone's leg; to tell someone a tall tale
literal: to tie a bear onto someone
example: Jetzt [bindest] du mir aber [einen Bären] [{auf}]!
example_en: Now you're pulling my leg!

phrase: Da wird ja der Hund in der Pfanne verrückt!
meaning: That's unbelievable!
literal: the dog in the frying pan goes crazy
example: Der Zug fällt schon wieder aus? [Da wird ja der Hund in der Pfanne verrückt]!
example_en: The train's cancelled again? That's unbelievable!

meaning: to keep your fingers crossed for someone
literal: to press your thumbs for someone
example: Morgen ist meine Prüfung – [drück] mir [die Daumen]!
example_en: My exam is tomorrow – keep your fingers crossed for me!

meaning: Break a leg! Good luck!
example: Viel Erfolg beim Vorstellungsgespräch – [Hals- und Beinbruch]!
example_en: Good luck at the interview – break a leg!

meaning: to be lucky
example: Ich [hatte Schwein]: Der letzte Bus hatte Verspätung, also hab ich ihn noch gekriegt.
example_en: I got lucky: the last bus was running late, so I still caught it.

meaning: That's not my problem / business
example: Wie er das Problem löst, [ist nicht mein Bier].
example_en: How he solves the problem is none of my business.

meaning: to be slow on the uptake; to not get it
example: Sorry, ich [stehe] gerade [auf dem Schlauch]. Was meinst du?
example_en: Sorry, I'm not getting it right now. What do you mean?

meaning: I don't believe it!
literal: I think my pig is whistling
example: Du hast die ganze Torte allein gegessen? [Ich glaub, mein Schwein pfeift]!
example_en: You ate the whole cake by yourself? I don't believe it!

meaning: to be fed up
example: Ich [habe die Nase voll] von diesem Regen.
example_en: I'm fed up with this rain.

meaning: to get on someone's nerves
example: Dein ständiges Jammern [geht] mir echt [auf den Keks].
example_en: Your constant moaning is really getting on my nerves.

meaning: to put your foot in it
literal: to step into the little pot of fat
example: Mit der Frage nach ihrem Alter bin ich voll [ins Fettnäpfchen getreten].
example_en: I really put my foot in it by asking her age.

meaning: to not feel like it; can't be bothered (casual)
example: Ich [hab] heute echt [keinen Bock] auf Sport.
example_en: I really can't be bothered with sport today.

phrase: etwas auf die lange Bank schieben
meaning: to put something off; to procrastinate
literal: to push something onto the long bench
example: [Schieb] die Steuererklärung nicht [auf die lange Bank]!
example_en: Don't keep putting off your tax return!

meaning: to buy a pig in a poke; to buy something sight unseen
literal: to buy the cat in the bag
example: Ich will das Auto erst sehen – ich [kaufe] doch nicht [die Katze im Sack].
example_en: I want to see the car first – I'm not buying it sight unseen.

meaning: to beat around the bush
literal: to talk around the hot porridge
example: [Red] nicht [um den heißen Brei] [{herum}] – was ist los?
example_en: Stop beating around the bush – what's going on?

meaning: Everything's fine
example: Keine Sorge, es ist [alles in Butter].
example_en: Don't worry, everything's fine.

meaning: to have a hangover
example: Die Party ging bis vier Uhr, heute [hab] ich [einen Kater].
example_en: The party went on until four; today I've got a hangover.

meaning: Don't mention it
example: Danke für deine Hilfe! – Ach, [nicht der Rede wert].
example_en: Thanks for your help! – Oh, don't mention it.

meaning: Get to the point! Out with it! Come clean! (casual, Low German-style bei + accusative)
example: Genug geredet – jetzt mal [Butter bei die Fische]: Was kostet das?
example_en: Enough talk – let's get to the point: how much is it?

meaning: to make a fool of yourself
literal: to make yourself into a monkey
example: [Mach] dich nicht [zum Affen]!
example_en: Don't make a fool of yourself!

meaning: All's well that ends well
example: Wir haben den Zug doch noch erwischt. [Ende gut, alles gut]!
example_en: We caught the train after all. All's well that ends well!

meaning: That's where the party is; it'll be lively
example: Komm am Samstag mit, [da steppt der Bär]!
example_en: Come along on Saturday, it's going to be wild!

phrase: zwei Fliegen mit einer Klappe schlagen
meaning: to kill two birds with one stone
literal: to swat two flies with one swatter
example: Wenn ich auf dem Heimweg einkaufe, [schlage] ich [zwei Fliegen mit einer Klappe].
example_en: If I shop on the way home, I kill two birds with one stone.

meaning: to be completely worn out; to be emotionally shattered
example: Nach der Nachtschicht [bin] ich [fix und fertig].
example_en: After the night shift I'm completely worn out.

meaning: in private; one-to-one
example: Können wir kurz [unter vier Augen] reden?
example_en: Can we have a quick word in private?

meaning: to make sense; to be well thought out (often negative: weder Hand noch Fuß haben)
example: Dein Plan [hat Hand und Fuß].
example_en: Your plan is well thought out.

meaning: Wait and see
example: Mehr können wir nicht tun – jetzt heißt es [abwarten und Tee trinken].
example_en: There's nothing more we can do – now we just have to wait and see.

meaning: a stone's throw; very close
example: Der Bahnhof ist nur [einen Katzensprung] von hier entfernt.
example_en: The station is just a stone's throw from here.

phrase: Mir fällt ein Stein vom Herzen.
meaning: That's a weight off my mind
literal: a stone falls from my heart
example: Du bist gut angekommen? Da [fällt mir ein Stein vom Herzen].
example_en: You got there safely? That's a weight off my mind.

meaning: to be on cloud nine
example: Seit sie verliebt ist, [schwebt] sie [auf Wolke sieben].
example_en: Ever since she fell in love, she's been on cloud nine.

meaning: nothing going on; dead (casual)
example: Am Sonntag ist hier echt [tote Hose].
example_en: On Sundays it's really dead around here.

meaning: That's on me (I'll pay / I take the blame)
example: Lass mal, das Essen [geht auf meine Kappe].
example_en: Leave it, dinner's on me.

meaning: to be all ears
example: Erzähl schon, ich [bin ganz Ohr]!
example_en: Go on, tell me – I'm all ears!

meaning: Life isn't always easy; life's not a bed of roses
literal: life is not a pony farm
example: Tja, [das Leben ist kein Ponyhof].
example_en: Well, life's not a bed of roses.

meaning: Lies don't get you far; the truth comes out
example: Er wurde sofort erwischt – [Lügen haben kurze Beine].
example_en: He was caught straight away – lies don't get you far.
